goal: Implement Orbit AI event recommendations for relationship and business-development goals.

success_criteria.description: An event recommendation service accepts a user goal and ranks events using attendee intent, event topic, schedule timing, relationship opportunities, and profile fit with source-backed reasons.
GET /app/agent event-discovery prompts display recommended events with why-this-event, people-to-meet, timing, confidence, and links to event detail pages.

Ten named evaluation cases cover meeting investors, finding China-market partners, hiring AI talent, restaurant expansion, organizer networking, language preference, schedule conflict, negative event filtering, Chinese input, and English input.
Focused tests assert ranking quality for the ten cases and prove irrelevant popular events are rejected when attendee/topic evidence does not match the goal.
The feature documentation records the design-evaluation-analysis loop and the accepted score threshold for presenting event recommendations.

out_of_scope: Creating new live event ingestion, ticketing, payments, or external calendar writes
Hardcoding one final recommendation response for each prompt
